collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: Tossing pebbles in a game, a teenager wonders whether distant people might play games of luck for great prizes.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Tossing pebbles in a game, (name1), a teenager, wonders whether distant people might play games of luck for great prizes.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The teenager imagines crowds cheering over a toss of dice.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: An elder worries that some might lose more than they can afford.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A child suggests distant people might play just for the fun of it, like Isolans.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A scholar says both could be true.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A villager wins five times in a row, and everyone suspects magic.

c1__fx.name: Outcome C1
c1__fx.text: The villagers play a pebble game for nothing but laughter.
